scenes.caption: Keep head and body in a straight line
scenes.narration_line: Make sure your baby's head and body stay in a straight line.

scenes.caption: Hold your baby close to you
scenes.narration_line: Hold your baby's body close to yours.

scenes.caption: Support their bottom, not just head and shoulders
scenes.narration_line: For a newborn, support their bottom too.

scenes.caption: Hold at the shoulders, not the head
scenes.narration_line: Hold your baby at the back of their shoulders.
safety_points: Never push your baby's head forward.
